mapper.sql: A.APPLY_ID AS applyId, A.TALENT_ID AS talentId, A.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, A.MESSAGE AS message, A.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, A.REG_DATE AS regDate, A.CONFIRM_DATE AS confirmDate
, M.NICKNAME AS nickname, M.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName, M.PHONE AS phone, T.TITLE AS talentTitle
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_TB_TALENT_APPLY.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_TALENT_APPLY ( APPLY_ID, TALENT_ID, MEMBER_NO, MESSAGE, STATUS_CD, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( #{applyId}, #{talentId}, #{memberNo}, #{message, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NVL(#{statusCd}, 'PENDING'), SYSDATE )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM TB_TALENT_APPLY A JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = A.MEMBER_NO JOIN TB_TALENT T ON T.TALENT_ID = A.TALENT_ID WHERE A.TALENT_ID = #{talentId} ORDER BY A.REG_DATE DESC

SELECT
FROM TB_TALENT_APPLY A JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = A.MEMBER_NO JOIN TB_TALENT T ON T.TALENT_ID = A.TALENT_ID JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_NO = T.BIZ_NO WHERE B.BIZ_ID = #{bizId} ORDER BY A.REG_DATE DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_TALENT_APPLY SET STATUS_CD = 'CONFIRMED', CONFIRM_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE APPLY_ID = #{applyId} AND STATUS_CD = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TALENT_APPLY A JOIN TB_TALENT T ON T.TALENT_ID = A.TALENT_ID JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_NO = T.BIZ_NO WHERE B.BIZ_ID = #{bizId} AND A.STATUS_CD = 'PENDING'
